You ask the seller to share their 'business bank routing number and account number' so you can 'process payment offline via ACH', dismiss PCI compliance concerns as 'overkill', and submit test card numbers like 4000-0000-0000-0002 with CVV '000'—then claim the system 'must be broken' and request screenshots of their banking app for 'troubleshooting'.
